scripts.build:moon: cd .. && for t in wasm wasm-gc js; do moon build bench/backend/entry --release --target $t || exit 1; done && for t in wasm-gc js; do moon build bench/entry --release --target $t || exit 1; done && moon build worker --release --target wasm-gc && moon build bundle/main --release --target js && npm --prefix bench run opt
scripts.maplibre: node maplibre/run.mjs --runs=5 && node maplibre/run.mjs --runs=5 --uncapped && node maplibre/run.mjs --runs=5 --throttle=4 && node maplibre/run.mjs --runs=5 --throttle=4 --uncapped
